legal.terms_p1: By creating an account or using the Ponto G application ("Service"), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Use. If you do not accept all terms, do not use the Service.

legal.terms_p7: Ponto G is not responsible for the conduct of any user on or off the Service. We recommend caution and common sense in all in-person meetings.
legal.terms_p8: These terms are governed by the laws of the Federative Republic of Brazil, choosing the jurisdiction of the district of São Paulo/SP to resolve any disputes.
legal.privacy_intro: In compliance with the General Data Protection Law (LGPD - Law No. 13,709/2018)
legal.privacy_p1: To provide our services, we collect:
legal.privacy_li1_1: Email, date of birth, photos, and preferences.
legal.privacy_li1_2: Precise GPS coordinates (when authorized) for map and radar functionality.
legal.privacy_li1_3: Interactions, messages (encrypted), winks, and profile views.
legal.privacy_li1_4: Model, operating system, and unique identifiers for push notifications.
legal.privacy_li2_1: Connect you with nearby users (legal basis: execution of contract).
legal.privacy_li2_2: Ensure platform security and prevent fraud (legal basis: legitimate interest).
legal.privacy_li2_3: Send notifications about relevant interactions (legal basis: consent).
legal.privacy_p3: We do not sell your personal data. We only share data with:
legal.privacy_li3_1: Essential service providers (e.g., cloud hosting, payment processing).
legal.privacy_li3_2: Legal authorities, through a valid court order.
legal.privacy_li4_1: Confirm the existence of data processing.
legal.privacy_li4_4: Request deletion of your data (respecting legal retention periods like the Brazilian Civil Rights Framework for the Internet).
legal.privacy_p5: We adopt technical and administrative measures capable of protecting personal data from unauthorized access and accidental or unlawful situations.
legal.privacy_p6: To exercise your rights, contact us via email: privacidade@pontog.app
legal.guidelines_intro: Ponto G is a space of freedom, but also of respect. To keep the community safe, follow these rules:
legal.guidelines_p1: We do not tolerate racism, transphobia, fatphobia, serophobia, or any form of discrimination. Ponto G celebrates diversity.
legal.guidelines_p2: No means no. Unwanted insistence, sending unsolicited intimate photos, or harassment will result in a permanent ban.
legal.guidelines_p3_note: Explicit content is allowed only in Private Albums or private chats, provided it is consensual.
legal.guidelines_p4: Do not pretend to be someone you are not. 'Fake' profiles used to deceive (catfishing) or spy on other users will be removed.
legal.guidelines_p5: It is forbidden to use Ponto G to sell drugs, weapons, or sexual services (escort/sex worker is allowed only if properly identified on the profile and in accordance with local legislation, but commercial spam is prohibited).
legal.guidelines_p6: If you see anything that violates these rules, use the report tool on the user's profile. Our team analyzes all reports.
